query: For CASE W20C, I need brake master cylinder.
response_text: {"key_facts":["For CASE W20C, the inspected brake catalog identifies the requested function as a treadle-operated brake valve assembly, not a separately named “master cylinder”: L73042, catalog quantity 2, in assembly 7-36 “Brake System, Reservoir to Treadles and Master Cylinders” (a158; observed 2026-11-04). Source: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/brake-system-reservoir-to-treadles-and-master-cylinders/cn/C88C7D55-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6.","The detailed inspected assembly 7-54 “L73042 Treadle and Brake Valve” confirms L73042 quantity 2 and describes it as “TREADLE AND VALVE ASSEMBLY - brake”; its internal valve assembly L15782 is listed as quantity 1. Source: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l73042-treadle-and-brake-valve/cn/1145AC82-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6.","The L73042 valve’s internal components are largely NSS (not sold separately), including the piston assembly, valve body, inlet/exhaust valve assembly, seals, springs and diaphragm. A repair kit L31806 is listed, quantity 1, for specified valve components. Source: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l73042-treadle-and-brake-valve/cn/1145AC82-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6.","Applicability is serial-dependent in the surrounding brake system: assembly 7-46 covers W20C before P.I.N. 9152331, while assembly 7-48 covers W20C at/after the catalog’s stated P.I.N. breakpoint. The inspected 7-48 assembly contains no separately identified master-cylinder part. Sources: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/brake-sys-treadle-to-hyd-rsrvoir-horn-used-bef-w18b-pin-9152103-bef-w20c-pin-9152331/cn/040CDD52-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6, https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/brake-sys-treadle-to-hyd-rsrvoir-horn-used-on-w18b-pin-9152103-aft-on-w20c-pin-91523/cn/69799144-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6.","The catalog is a dated partial machine snapshot for W20C North America production 01/82–12/89; serial/PIN-specific fitment is not confirmed. If “master cylinder” means the catalog’s L73042 treadle/brake valve, L73042 is the observed candidate; otherwise the requested component remains unresolved as a separately named cylinder."],"sources":["https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/brake-system-reservoir-to-treadles-and-master-cylinders/cn/C88C7D55-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6","https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l73042-treadle-and-brake-valve/cn/1145AC82-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6","https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/brake-valve/p/L73042","https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/brake-sys-treadle-to-hyd-rsrvoir-horn-used-bef-w18b-pin-9152103-bef-w20c-pin-9152331/cn/040CDD52-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6","https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/brake-sys-treadle-to-hyd-rsrvoir-horn-used-on-w18b-pin-9152103-aft-on-w20c-pin-91523/cn/69799144-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6"],"store_url":"https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/brake-valve/p/L73042"}

key_facts: For CASE W20C, the inspected brake catalog identifies the requested function as a treadle-operated brake valve assembly, not a separately named “master cylinder”: L73042, catalog quantity 2, in assembly 7-36 “Brake System, Reservoir to Treadles and Master Cylinders” (a158; observed 2026-11-04). Source: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/brake-system-reservoir-to-treadles-and-master-cylinders/cn/C88C7D55-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6.

The detailed inspected assembly 7-54 “L73042 Treadle and Brake Valve” confirms L73042 quantity 2 and describes it as “TREADLE AND VALVE ASSEMBLY - brake”; its internal valve assembly L15782 is listed as quantity 1. Source: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l73042-treadle-and-brake-valve/cn/1145AC82-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6.

The L73042 valve’s internal components are largely NSS (not sold separately), including the piston assembly, valve body, inlet/exhaust valve assembly, seals, springs and diaphragm. A repair kit L31806 is listed, quantity 1, for specified valve components. Source: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l73042-treadle-and-brake-valve/cn/1145AC82-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6.

Applicability is serial-dependent in the surrounding brake system: assembly 7-46 covers W20C before P.I.N. 9152331, while assembly 7-48 covers W20C at/after the catalog’s stated P.I.N. breakpoint. The inspected 7-48 assembly contains no separately identified master-cylinder part. Sources: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/brake-sys-treadle-to-hyd-rsrvoir-horn-used-bef-w18b-pin-9152103-bef-w20c-pin-9152331/cn/040CDD52-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6, https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/brake-sys-treadle-to-hyd-rsrvoir-horn-used-on-w18b-pin-9152103-aft-on-w20c-pin-91523/cn/69799144-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6.

The catalog is a dated partial machine snapshot for W20C North America production 01/82–12/89; serial/PIN-specific fitment is not confirmed. If “master cylinder” means the catalog’s L73042 treadle/brake valve, L73042 is the observed candidate; otherwise the requested component remains unresolved as a separately named cylinder.
